policy.selection: One Han segment per prepared near-duplicate family per partition; order by SHA256(seed + partition + recordId + segment); half of each partition per length stratum. No decoder/lexicon/model output is consulted.
policy.leakageAudit: After sampling, exclude exact/substring and edit-distance<=1 overlaps with earlier corpus partitions (dev vs train; test vs train and dev). Record every exclusion without replacement. Thus accepted counts may be below sampled counts.
policy.annotation: Agent review of every selected text and proposed syllable sequence, before any candidate output; explicit status/note per row. Preserve awkward but interpretable source text. Any exclusion must be recorded, not silently replaced. This is not a human-annotated gold claim.
policy.measurement: Unspaced full-pinyin, empty editor context, candidateLimit 255, exact source reconstruction and Unicode CER; no post-result homophone aliases.
policy.selectionTieBreak: top1 descending, CER ascending, top3 descending, LM weight ascending; otherwise choose legacy
policy.testUse: Only legacy and the frozen development-selected mode. Freeze source/model/data hashes before test. Do not retune from this test or present later runs as first-use held-out results.
